employmentTypeRules.name: Full-Time
employmentTypeRules.description: Permanent & confirmed staff subject to standard statutory PAYE tax and 8% employee / 10% employer pension.

employmentTypeRules.name: Part-Time
employmentTypeRules.description: Hourly/part-time workers exempt from statutory pension and standard payroll PAYE.

employmentTypeRules.name: Contract
employmentTypeRules.description: Fixed-term independent contractors without statutory pension deductions (exempt from standard payroll PAYE).

employmentTypeRules.name: Intern / NYSC
employmentTypeRules.description: Student interns and national service corps members exempt from pension and standard payroll tax.
